interpretation.plain_speak: The durable exception was not hiding in a richer age/hand pattern. All four horizon-16 cases were geometrically identical at the decision point, yet one survived and three did not. What happens later in the stream matters.
interpretation.north_star_question: Defines a hard observability boundary: immediate risk is native-state predictable, but long-horizon intervention durability can depend on future interactions not encoded in current replacement geometry.
interpretation.next_stage: shift C-lane from permanent-outcome prediction to bounded-horizon guarantees: measure how many subsequent unique writes a guided refresh can guarantee protection against from current state alone, without predicting the full future stream
